clips.title: The story
paras: At Tarren Mill, a Horde rogue seeks Serge Hinott's help against Zanzil's poison. The Forsaken chemist studies the toxin and prepares a cure.

After a Barrens assignment leaves you suffering from a toxin that clouds the mind, you are sent north to Tarren Mill. Serge Hinott, a Forsaken chemist, studies the poison made by Zanzil, a jungle troll exile. Hinott cares little about the troll's identity or kin. He admires the brew's vicious effect and wants to understand how it works before making an antidote.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have never seen such wondrous results from a poison! Zanzil you say? Never heard of him, however, I must commend him on the creation of this concoction.
So, I am to cure you of this and then teach you how to make use of the poison?
Give me a few moments to examine the toxin, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The cure is ready! Drink this anti-toxin and the creeping madness will stop, however, I will not be able to do anything about the smell.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
